text:
You’re copying an image pixel by pixel, but the output is ending up smaller than the 360 x 225 source and consistently rendering as 300 x 150.

Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne. I have 7 years of experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS.

I’ve built an end-to-end test suite for Kestrel Insurance using Playwright, GitHub Actions, Docker, and TypeScript, creating browser tests for the broker quoting flow that run on every pull request. That suite covered 160 tests and helped reduce release regressions from 6 a quarter to 1.

For your image-copy test, I’d look at canvas sizing, drawing context dimensions, and any implicit default width/height behavior so the output matches the source exactly.
